title: S5 Coordination Issue Lifecycle

entries.name: Open
entries.meaning: Confirmed coordination defect assigned for action.

entries.name: In Progress
entries.meaning: Responsible discipline is actively implementing remediation.

entries.name: Resolved
entries.meaning: Author/discipline asserts that remediation is complete and republished.

entries.name: Verified
entries.meaning: Independent re-test confirms physical resolution; pending governance closure.

entries.name: Closed
entries.meaning: Governance closure recorded with audit linkage.

entries.name: Accepted Condition / Waived
entries.meaning: Collision accepted by joint documented approval rather than geometric removal.

entries.name: Rejected / Returned to WIP
entries.meaning: Proposed fix failed verification or introduced non-conformance.

conflict_note: Core doctrine contains an illustrative four-state progression, while ACC implementation uses the more detailed lifecycle above. This registry records the extracted implementation lifecycle without declaring the source conflict fully resolved.
